captions.detailed: A rescue-service blimp featuring a long, red aerodynamic envelope hull, a grey rectangular gondola cabin suspended underneath, and a cruciform tail configuration. Two propulsion pods with dark grey propellers are mounted on the sides of the envelope. The model features articulation including continuous rotation of the twin propeller blades, a yawing rudder on the vertical fin, pitching elevators on the horizontal stabilizers, and a spinning mooring wheel in a small fork under the rear cabin.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of a rescue-service blimp with a long red envelope hull, a grey gondola underneath, and a cruciform tail. Include twin side-mounted propulsion pods with rotating propellers, a functional rudder on the vertical stabilizer, pitching elevators, and a rotating mooring wheel under the rear cabin.
captions.factory: Construct the main envelope by lofting or scaling a sphere into an elongated ellipsoid. Build the gondola using a rectangular prism, connecting it to the hull with small cylindrical struts. Model the cruciform tail fins using extruded sketches, and add separate bodies for the rudder and elevators connected via revolute joints. Create the propulsion pods with cylindrical shafts and small multi-blade propellers attached via continuous rotational joints. Finally, model the mooring wheel and its support fork under the rear of the cabin.
